page_title: MAR 2-0 BRE | Marseille v Brest 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Jeremy Stinat has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' A cross from a corner kick by Brest is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+6' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+6' Hiang'a Mbock (Brest) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+4' Great save! Matteo Guendouzi (Marseille) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Marco Bizot.
90+2' The game is interrupted now, Renan Lodi (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+2' Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
90+1' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Marco Bizot is alert and makes a decent save.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo makes his way off the pitch and Hiang'a Mbock (Brest) comes on as his replacement.
89' Kenny Lala (Brest) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
87' Martin Satriano (Brest) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
87' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
86' The corner from Matteo Guendouzi (Marseille) is intercepted by the defence.
85' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille).
84' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes.
80' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Matteo Guendouzi (Marseille) replaces Ismaila Sarr.
78' Jonas Martin (Brest) gets inside the box and tries to beat Pau Lopez with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
77' A cross from a corner kick by Brest is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
75' A substitution has been made. Jeremy Le Douaron is replaced by Karamoko Dembele (Brest).

72' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
71' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

71' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Bizot makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Marseille.
71' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
70' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

68' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) pounces on a loose pass, cuts inside an opponent and unleashes a piledriver towards goal. The keeper scrambles to save the effort, but it curls just wide of the right post.
67' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
65' 2 - 0 Goal! 2:0. Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha (Marseille) comes onto the pitch for Iliman Ndiaye.
64' Jonas Martin (Brest) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
62' Substitution. Martin Satriano (Brest) replaces Steve Mounie.
61' Here is a change. Hugo Magnetti is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Jonas Martin (Brest).
59' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Pau Lopez, who smothers the ball.

57' What a save from Pau Lopez! Steve Mounie (Brest) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
57' A corner kick by Brest is thwarted by the well prepared Pau Lopez (Marseille).
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
56' Mahdi Camara (Brest) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.
53' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the right post.
53' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Steve Mounie (Brest) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
50' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) whips in a cross from the corner, but Marco Bizot is well positioned and punches the ball away.
49' Problems for Marcelino as Amine Harit is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) replaces him.
48' Amine Harit (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' None of the Brest players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
47' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

46' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Brest have a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.

43' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
42' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
41' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
39' A cross from a corner kick by Brest is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

38' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
36' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
34' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kenny Lala (Brest).

30' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Pau Lopez makes a great save to stop his effort.
29' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
28' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

28' Mahdi Camara (Brest) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Pau Lopez is alert and denies him with a nice save. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' A decent cross gives Steve Mounie (Brest) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
23' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
21' Bradley Locko (Brest) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremy Stinat who sees an offensive foul.
20' Kenny Lala (Brest) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
17' That's a well-taken pass by Amine Harit (Marseille). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
15' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Pau Lopez makes a comfortable save.
14' Amine Harit (Marseille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
12' Bradley Locko (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
11' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
11' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
8' The Marseille players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.

3' Lilian Brassier (Brest) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul.
